notes: Qty 59 as published: 'Starting (7)' counts the line 'Hidden base Modifier (pick one of the systems below)', which is one of the systems listed under Systems, not a separate card.

Starting cards as posted: Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers, the chosen system, Heading For The Medical Frigate ('HFTMF'), Your Insight Serves You Well, Wise Advice, Do, Or Do Not and Rendezvous Point. Several Effects start, so starting.effect is empty. Wise Advice and Do, Or Do Not are the Dagobah Effects (not Defensive Shields).

Posted 'Lando in Hot Rod' dested Lando In Millennium Falcon (the strategy says 'I added Lando in ship'); 'Luke Skywalker, JN' Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'R2-D2' R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo); 'HOTJedi' Honor Of The Jedi; 'Slayn and Korpil Facilities' Slayn & Korpil Facilities.
The post says the deck type went undefeated but one game at the author's last tournament in an earlier version; no event is named.
